products.short_description: Get Google Workspace CMMC Level 2 assessment-ready — NIST SP 800-171 control mapping, CUI boundary, Assured Controls/GCC configuration + evidence, and the SSP & POA&M — so the tenant is configured, evidenced, and ready for a C3PAO. products.description:
Get Google Workspace ready for CMMC Level 2 assessment

Defense-supply-chain organizations handling CUI on Google Workspace must meet CMMC Level 2 — the 110 NIST SP 800-171 controls — and be ready for a C3PAO assessment. This solution is the readiness playbook: map the applicable NIST 800-171 controls to Google Workspace capabilities (Assured Controls, access, DLP, logging, encryption), configure and evidence them, define the CUI boundary, and build the SSP and POA&M — so the tenant is configured, evidenced, and assessment-ready. Certification determinations stay with your assessor/compliance team.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — CMMC L2 and the NIST 800-171 control families, the CUI boundary on Google Workspace, Assured Controls / GCC enablement, and the SSP/POA&M/evidence model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace edition supporting Assured Controls/GCC, CUI scope, compliance/assessor stakeholders, data map).
  • Implementation Guide — define the CUI boundary, map NIST 800-171 controls to Workspace configuration, apply and evidence the controls (access, DLP, logging, encryption, MFA), and build the SSP + POA&M — pilot-first; assessment/certification determinations deferred to the C3PAO/compliance.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or operations helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health or control check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (controls configured + evidenced, SSP/POA&M complete, boundary enforced) plus Best Practices; NIST 800-171 references cited, assessment outcomes not asserted.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Google Workspace configured, evidenced, and CMMC Level 2 assessment-ready — NIST 800-171 controls mapped and applied, CUI boundary enforced, SSP and POA&M in hand — the certification call stays with your assessor.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • assess-nist-controls.py — map NIST SP 800-171 controls to Google Workspace settings and report status
    • collect-evidence.py — export configuration + audit-log evidence for the CUI boundary into a package
    • cui-boundary-check.py — check the CUI boundary OU for sharing/access exposure (read-only)
    • cui-scope-helper.py — plan/scaffold the CUI boundary OU, pilot group, and named control artifacts
    • generate-ssp-poam.py — draft the SSP and POA&M from the NIST 800-171 control map

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
